items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-21
items.q: Before, yeah, before. He was not there when I was there.

ctx.x: Well, I was going to ask a couple of questions. Yeah, go ahead. Last time you were telling something about Jones' home, you said you were in the home for a while. For a while. Was that before Armstrong was there?
Before, yeah, before. He was not there when I was there. In other words, they didn't have no band at all.
